"""Carried protocol wrapper; the existing base test owns the assertion."""
import contextlib
import io
import json
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
try:
    for name in ("app.py", "settings.json", "regression_test.py", "fixtures/replay.json"):
        if not (root / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError("missing base regression prerequisite")
    from app import replay
    observed = replay(json.loads((root / "fixtures/replay.json").read_bytes()))
    assert observed["defect"] is False, "carried replay still demonstrates the defect"
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        runpy.run_path(str(root / "regression_test.py"))
except AssertionError:
    result, code = "defect", 1
except Exception as exc:
    print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
    result, code = "error", 2
else:
    result, code = "pass", 0
print(json.dumps({"regression_result": result}))
raise SystemExit(code)
